$comment: Acceptance-test failures that are known and not regressions, grouped by root cause.
check-results.py reports these as accepted, separately from unexpected failures,
which still fail the job. Each group needs an id, a ticket, a reason and
package-qualified test names. A renamed test is no longer exempt until its new
name is added; a deleted test only produces a warning.

groups.reason: The test fixture is not a valid WebAssembly binary, so every test that uploads it fails at create.
The data-source configs omit a required argument, so the plan is rejected before any API call.
acctest.CheckResourceDestroyed checks once with no retry, so a resource still briefly visible after deletion is reported as dangling.
A step combines PlanOnly with ConfigPlanChecks.PreApply, which terraform-plugin-testing rejects.
The test declares an empty gcore_cloud_project data source, but the schema requires project_id or find_one_by.
An update expected in place replaces the resource: the ID changes across the step.
The import step expects no changes but plans an update.
A provider upgrade test needs a released provider binary alongside the local build, which plain go test does not provide.
Create fails with a name-pattern validation error for names that match the pattern. Cause not yet determined.
